newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION - Selectors name All Black trialists.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - Selectors name All Black trialists.

text.p: New Zealand's rugby selectors on Tuesday named a tried and true lineup for their shadow test team to play New Zealand A in the All Black trial on June 8 at Rotorua.
Rather than be swayed by form displayed in the Super 12 series, the selectors have retained most of last year's test side, which won nine of 10 internationals.
The only non-test player included in the shadow side is Auckland's Charles Riechelmann, who will play at blindside flanker instead of Michael Jones, who doesn't play on Sundays for religious reasons.
Lee Stensness, as expected, has been given the second five-eighth berth in the shadow test team in the absence of the injured Walter Little.
Canterbury's Mark Mayerhofler will play at second five-eighth in the New Zealand A team.

Selection convener and All Black coach John Hart said the trial would serve as valuable match preparation for the shadow All Black side before the test against Fiji at North Harbour Stadium on June 14.

"It is also a vital game for players in the New Zealand A team in terms of pressing for test positions and showing they have the ability to impress for selection in the 36-man squad to tour Britain in November," he said.

Hart said the selectors also would be watching the New Zealand Academy 15's game against Ireland A at North Harbour next Monday, the South Island Invitation 15 match against Fiji on May 27 and the New Zealand Maori trial at Tauranga on June 6.

NZ Barbarians: Christian Cullen, Jeff Wilson, Frank Bunce, Glen Osborne, Lee Stensness, Andrew Mehrtens, Justin Marshall, Zinzan Brooke, Josh Kronfeld, Ian Jones, Robin Brooke, Charles Riechelmann, Craig Dowd, Sean Fitzpatrick (captain), Olo Brown.
Reserves: Jon Preston, Scott McLeod, Tana Umaga, Mark Allen, Norm Hewitt, Taine Randell.

New Zealand A: Adrian Cashmore, James Kerr, Eroni Clarke, Eric Rush, Mark Mayerhofler, Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u, Steve Surridge, Mark Carter, Mark Cooksley, Glenn Taylor, Todd Blackadder (captain), Paul Thomson, Anton Oliver, Con Barrell.
Reserves: Darryl Lilley, Jeremy Stanley, Leon McDonald, Mark Robinson, Shane McDonald, Norm Maxwell, Kee Meeuws, Andrew Blowers.
Players not considered: Michael Jones, Walter Little, Alama Ieremia, Chresten Davis, Jonah Lomu, Blair Larsen, Joeli Vidiri, Dylan Mika.
